origin: Original analytic pixel values authored for this Aura3D source test; no external image or engine asset was used.

channels.R: FLOAT, full resolution, unrelated root layer

expectations.coordinates: x and y are zero-based within the data window; sx and sy are the stored 2x2 sample coordinates nearest to x and y, with ties toward the higher coordinate and edge clamping.

referenceVerification.encoderReadback: OpenEXR 3.4.6 InputFile read every Y, RY, BY, A and root R sample exactly after ZIP encoding.
referenceVerification.header: exrheader 3.4.6 reported version 2, the named channels and sampling, chromaticities, ZIP compression and the data window recorded above.
referenceVerification.reproducibility: Two consecutive generator invocations produced the same SHA-256.
